rows.grounds: First member of compound veśma-bhū-pura-yugmena (v.13738); denotes house/dwelling.
Second member of compound veśma-bhū-pura-yugmena (v.13738); denotes earth/ground.
Third member of compound veśma-bhū-pura-yugmena (v.13738); denotes city/town.
Final member of compound veśma-bhū-pura-yugmena (v.13738); instrumental sense indicating accompaniment by a pair.
Locative-form token koṇeṣu (v.13738); indicates location in the corners.
Bīja/seed-syllable token (v.13738); transliterated only per Śrīvidyā mantra practice.
Optative-form verb samālikhet (v.13738); prescribes the act of drawing/inscribing.
